summary: Frontend-only retest of the i18n items still broken in iteration_30, using the mobile web preview at 375x667. Before each check the runtime cache '@zenrex_autot_cache_v2' was cleared. VERIFIED FIXED: (1) useAutoT runtime translations. On My Returns in en, the 3 reasons ('I changed my mind' / 'Product does not match the order' / 'Manufacturing defect') appear within 1.5s with no reload, persist to the cache and stay translated after reload. The preset role names and descriptions on merchant/roles translate on demand in en/de within about 8s with no reload. (2) The SAMA ribbon reads correctly in all 3 languages: en '🛡 Licensed by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) · 3 payment options', de '... · 3 Zahlungsoptionen', zh '... · 3 种支付方式'. (3) In zh My Returns, the header reads '5 个退货申请' and the labels 已退款 / 制造缺陷 are correct. (4) Service tab shows Experiences (0) / Erfahrungen (0). Roles header shows '5 roles' / '5 Rollen'. (5) Driver SAR, Active (N), Available (N) are translated in de/en/zh/he. (6) Support 'WhatsApp' label, Arabic Home 'N مُباع', LoyaltyRedeemPicker '1 Point =' / '1 Punkt =' / '1积分 =', and the inventory tabs are all translated. (7) /merchant/inventory loads in ar/en/de/zh/he. REGRESSION: no pageerrors or crashes on 20 customer routes in zh/he/en, 18 merchant routes in ar/en/de/zh/he, or the driver dashboard in 5 languages. STILL BROKEN or NEW: (a) The driver Status value 'متصل' stays Arabic in every non-Arabic language. It is not in the static dictionary, and driver/index.tsx never calls useT(), so it does not re-render when the translation arrives. 'No {tab} orders' is hardcoded English in every language, including ar. (b) Warranties status 'ساري' stays Arabic on the first visit in en/de until reload, for the same no-useT() reason. In en it then reads 'Current'. (c) Wrong dictionary entries on Roles and Support. (d) Raw i18n keys appear on /group-buys and /points. No deprecated Expo packages were checked or changed in this iteration.

These files use tSync/tf without calling useT(), so they never update until reload: app/chamber.tsx, app/competition/[id].tsx, app/driver/index.tsx, app/warranties.tsx, app/addresses.tsx, app/draw.tsx, app/track-order/[id].tsx, src/components/LoyaltyRedeemPicker.tsx. Fix: call `const { lang } = useT();` in each one (and pass lang instead of curLang()), or pre-bake the strings.

critical_code_review_comments: The useAutoT v3 design is sound: the shared in-flight Map, loading the cache before writing, the merge on load, and the debounced event bus all work. The weak point is that the event only reaches components that consume I18nContext. Screens using curLang() bypass it, so the bus fix does not apply to them.

translationEvents.emitTranslationArrived only fires when translated !== source. That is fine, but a failed fetch is never retried in the same session because translate() returns the source and nothing is cached. This is acceptable.

The same Arabic source string is used with different meanings (العنوان = title/address, نقص, جاهز, الطلبات). The one-to-one static dictionary cannot disambiguate these, so use distinct source strings per context.

rca_of_issue: Untranslated text on the driver and warranties screens: tSync() returns the Arabic source and starts a background fetch. When the fetch resolves, emitTranslationArrived → I18nProvider setTick → a new context value object, which only re-renders components that call useContext via useT(). driver/index.tsx and warranties.tsx import useT but never call it; they read curLang(). So they are not re-rendered, and the Arabic source stays until remount. Reproduce: clear the cache, set app_lang=de, open /driver, wait 6s, and the status still shows 'متصل'. Mitigation: call useT() in those screens, or pre-bake the strings.
